title: `1.0.0` Release
description:
## chronicle.reports 1.0.0

This release adds Workbench session reporting, CSV exports, Connect Gallery distribution, and AWS service-account OAuth support. It also includes breaking changes that require Chronicle data from Connect and Workbench **2026.06.0 or later**.

### What's new

- **Workbench session reporting.** New reports backed by three curated datasets: `workbench/session_start_totals`, `workbench/session_start_totals_by_user`, and `workbench/session_duration` (available in Workbench 2026.06.0+).
- **CSV downloads.** Added download buttons to the Connect and Workbench dashboards so users can export the data behind tables and charts.
- **Connect Gallery distribution.** Published the `connect` and `workbench` apps as Posit Connect Gallery extensions for direct installation.
- **AWS service-account OAuth.** Added support for Posit Connect's AWS service-account OAuth integration.

### ⚠️ Breaking changes

- **Connect Usage report now uses new datasets.** It reads `connect/content_hits_totals` and `connect/content_hits_totals_by_user`; the previous visits-based content usage view has been removed. This version requires data from Chronicle running in Connect and Workbench **2026.06.0+**. Pointing the dashboards at older Chronicle data will cause the affected reports to fail to load.
- **Removed `"hourly"` raw metrics.** `chronicle_raw_data()` and `chronicle_list_raw_data()` now only accept `frequency = "daily"`.

### Upgrade notes

Before upgrading, ensure your Chronicle deployment is collecting data from Connect and Workbench 2026.06.0 or later. Any dashboards or scripts relying on `frequency = "hourly"` must be updated to use `"daily"`.

title: feat(connect): support aws oauth integration pathway
description:
### Intent

When the chronicle report reads chronicle data from S3, it previously relied on Arrow's default AWS credential chain (env vars / instance profile). This adds support for Posit Connect's AWS service-account OAuth integration, so deployed content can read S3 using temporary credentials scoped to an assigned IAM role.

### Approach

- New internal `chronicle_fs()` helper resolves a data path to an Arrow source: local paths pass through unchanged; on Connect it exchanges the content session token for temporary AWS credentials via `connectapi::get_aws_content_credentials()` and builds an `arrow::s3_bucket()` with them. If the fetch fails (i.e. no AWS integration assigned), it falls back to Arrow's default credential chain.
- `chronicle_data()`, `chronicle_raw_data()`, and `chronicle_list_dirs()` now route S3 access through `chronicle_fs()`.
- `connectapi` added to Imports (so manifests/renv.lock will need to be rebuilt)

### Notes

Content reading from S3 on Connect needs:
  - An AWS service-account integration assigned to the content.
  - `CHRONICLE_BASE_PATH` and `AWS_REGION` set in the content env

title: switch to content hits
description:
This is a Claude-written update to replace content visits and shiny usage with content hits. This PR goes with https://github.com/posit-dev/chronicle/pull/250.

---

# Plan: Replace Content Visits & Shiny Usage with Content Hits

## Context

Chronicle is replacing two separate usage metrics — **content visits** (`content_visits_totals_by_user`) and **shiny usage** (`shiny_usage_totals_by_user`) — with a single unified **content hits** metric. The new metric has two datasets already defined in Chronicle:

- `content_hits_totals`: environment, content_guid, hits (int64), unique_users (int64), date
- `content_hits_totals_by_user`: environment, content_guid, user_guid, hits (int64), date

The sample data generators for content hits already exist in `R/sample-data.R`. The old generators and all UI/server code referencing visits and shiny usage need to be removed and replaced.

## Key Design Decision

Use `content_hits_totals_by_user` as the **sole data source** for both new tabs (matching the old pattern where `content_visits_totals_by_user` served both the overview and by-user tabs). This keeps the reactive chain simple — one lazy-load instead of two.

The Usage nav menu consolidates from 4 tabs → 2 tabs:
- "Content Hits" (overview with value boxes + charts)
- "Content Hits by User" (detailed table with joins to user_list and content_list)

---

## Step 1: Update sample data (`R/sample-data.R`)

**Remove:**
- `sample_connect_visits_by_user_internal()` function (~lines 689–805)
- `sample_connect_shiny_by_user_internal()` function (~lines 808–944)
- `write_sample_parquet_internal()` calls for `connect/content_visits_totals_by_user` (lines 1418–1422) and `connect/shiny_usage_totals_by_user` (lines 1424–1428)

**Update:**
- Roxygen doc block (lines 18–19): remove bullets for "Connect content visits" and "Connect Shiny usage"

**Keep as-is:**
- `sample_connect_content_hits_totals_by_user_internal()` (line 947)
- `sample_connect_content_hits_totals_internal()` (line 1059)
- Their `write_sample_parquet_internal()` calls (lines 1430–1440)

---

## Step 2: Replace UI/Server in Connect dashboard (`inst/apps/connect/app.R`)

### 2a. Remove old UI/Server pairs (4 sections, ~lines 1390–2772)

| Section | Approx Lines | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `usage_overview_ui` / `usage_overview_server` | 1390–1751 | Visits overview |
| `shiny_apps_ui` / `shiny_apps_server` | 1753–2192 | Shiny app usage |
| `content_by_user_ui` / `content_by_user_server` | 2194–2466 | Visits by user table |
| `shiny_sessions_by_user_ui` / `shiny_sessions_by_user_server` | 2468–2772 | Shiny sessions by user table |

### 2b. Add new `content_hits_overview_ui` / `content_hits_overview_server`

**UI** (mirrors `usage_overview_ui` pattern):
- Environment filter + date range
- 3 value boxes: "Total Hits" (GREEN), "Unique Users" (BLUE), "Avg Daily Hits" (BURGUNDY)
- Chart: "Total Hits by Day" with download popovers
- Chart: "Unique Users by Day" with download popovers

**Server** (`content_hits_overview_server(input, output, session, content_hits_by_user)`):
- Receives `content_hits_totals_by_user` reactive
- Filters by environment and date range
- Value boxes: `sum(hits)`, `n_distinct(user_guid)`, `sum(hits)/num_days`
- Charts: `group_by(date) |> summarise(total_hits = sum(hits))` and `group_by(date) |> summarise(unique_users = n_distinct(user_guid))`
- Download handlers for chart CSV and raw data CSV

### 2c. Add new `content_hits_by_user_ui` / `content_hits_by_user_server`

**UI** (mirrors `content_by_user_ui` pattern):
- Card header with download button
- Environment filter + date range
- `DT::dataTableOutput` for the table

**Server** (`content_hits_by_user_server(input, output, session, content_hits_by_user, content_list, user_list)`):
- Aggregation: `group_by(environment, user_guid, content_guid) |> summarise(total_hits = sum(hits))`
- Joins with user_list (for username) and content_list (for title)
- Download handler exports CSV

### 2d. Update main UI (nav_menu, ~line 2802)

Replace the Usage nav_menu entries:
```r
bslib::nav_menu(
  "Usage",
  bslib::nav_panel("Content Hits", content_hits_overview_ui, value = "content_hits_overview"),
  bslib::nav_panel("Content Hits by User", content_hits_by_user_ui, value = "content_hits_by_user")
)
```

### 2e. Update main server (~lines 2964–3086)

**Remove:**
- `should_load_content_visits` / `content_visits_range` / `all_content_visits` reactive chain (lines 2964–2997)
- `should_load_shiny_usage` / `shiny_usage_range` / `all_shiny_usage` reactive chain (lines 2999–3032)
- `load_more_observer` calls for `content_visits_range` and `shiny_usage_range` (lines 3056–3059)
- Sub-server calls: `usage_overview_server`, `shiny_apps_server`, `content_by_user_server`, `shiny_sessions_by_user_server` (lines 3068–3085)

**Add:**
- `should_load_content_hits` / `content_hits_range` / `all_content_hits_by_user` reactive chain loading `connect/content_hits_totals_by_user`
- Trigger on tabs: `content_hits_overview`, `content_hits_by_user`
- `load_more_observer(content_hits_range, "content_hits_overview_date_range")`
- `load_more_observer(content_hits_range, "content_hits_by_user_date_range")`
- Sub-server calls: `content_hits_overview_server(...)`, `content_hits_by_user_server(...)`

**Update:**
- `should_load_content_list` observer: replace `shiny_apps`, `content_by_user`, `shiny_sessions_by_user` with `content_hits_by_user` (line 2937–2939)
- `should_load_user_list` observer: replace `content_by_user`, `shiny_sessions_by_user` with `content_hits_by_user` (lines 2882–2883)

---

## Step 3: Update tests (`tests/testthat/test_downloads.R`)

**Remove** 4 test blocks (~lines 244–409):
- "Connect: usage overview downloads work"
- "Connect: shiny apps downloads work"
- "Connect: content by user download works"
- "Connect: shiny sessions by user download works"

**Add** 2 new test blocks:
- "Connect: content hits overview downloads work" — loads `content_hits_totals_by_user`, tests chart and raw download handlers
- "Connect: content hits by user download works" — loads `content_hits_totals_by_user` + `content_list` + `user_list`, tests table download

---

## Step 4: Update documentation

- **README.md** (~lines 283–291): Update `chronicle_list_data()` output to replace `content_visits_totals_by_user` and `shiny_usage_totals_by_user` with `content_hits_totals` and `content_hits_totals_by_user`
- **man/chronicle_sample_data.Rd**: Auto-generated — run `devtools::document()` after updating roxygen in `R/sample-data.R`

---

## Verification

1. `devtools::load_all()` — ensure package loads without errors
2. `devtools::test()` — all tests pass
3. `chronicle_run_app("connect", base_path = chronicle_sample_data())` — manually verify:
   - Usage > Content Hits tab shows value boxes and charts with data
   - Usage > Content Hits by User tab shows table with usernames and content titles
   - Downloads work for all chart/raw/table exports
   - Date range and environment filters work correctly
4. `devtools::document()` — regenerate docs
5. `devtools::check()` — no warnings or errors
